subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be permitted to install or reuse a process-wide plugin under exact-plan consent, or should plugin package mutation wait for a separate host-level grant model?
rationale: This choice defines authority across sibling agents and cannot be resolved from correctness tests or package integrity checks alone.

options.title: Approve explicit shared-host consent
options.body: Keep the current model if the exact preview and `--yes --plan-integrity` confirmation are considered a sufficient operator grant for shared plugin effects.

options.title: Defer plugin mutation
options.body: Land only agent-workspace skill support now and keep plugin declarations blocked until a dedicated host or Scout grant is designed.

options.title: Require stronger host scoping
options.body: Define a distinct host-level authorization flow before allowing any Claw manifest to mutate shared plugin state.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit shared-host consent
recommendation.body: Keep the current model if the exact preview and `--yes --plan-integrity` confirmation are considered a sufficient operator grant for shared plugin effects.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review identifies the unresolved cross-agent shared-plugin authority boundary directly.
